npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.dating_acce: You... like me? Mmm... I think I need a moment to wake up properly. Oh... you really mean it? Well, I like you too, %player%. I'd love to spend more time together.
I never thought someone would want to spend their time with someone as sleepy as me. But... I really like being around you. So yes, I'd love that.
Mmm... I think I'd rather spend my afternoons sleeping beside you than anywhere else. Is that a good enough answer? Because it's a yes.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.dating_deny: Oh... that's very sweet of you. I'm just not sure I feel the same way. I hope we can still enjoy each other's company, though.
Mmm... I'm flattered, really. But I don't think my heart is quite there. Sorry, %player%.
You're wonderful, but... I think I'd rather keep things as they are. I hope that's alright.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.default_gif: Oh... something for me? Mmm, thank you. That's rather thoughtful of you. I'll put it somewhere safe... probably.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.dislike.1: Oh... thank you. It's not really my kind of thing, but... I suppose it's nice of you to think of me.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.divorce.1: Oh... I see. I suppose even the nicest dreams have to end eventually. I won't stop you, %player%. I just wish things had turned out differently.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.divorce.2: Mmm... so we're going our separate ways? That's alright. I won't hold it against you. Thank you for all the peaceful moments we shared.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.divorce.3: I understand... I guess I'll have to get used to sleeping alone again. Take care of yourself, alright?
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.divorce_err: Divorce...? Mmm... did I fall asleep during our wedding? Because I don't remember getting married.
Oh... I think you've skipped a step there, %player%. We aren't married yet. Maybe you should get some sleep too.
Mmm... that's a lot of effort for something we haven't even started. We're not married, you know.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.first.1: Mmmh...? Oh... hello. Sorry, I wasn't expecting anyone. I was just... resting my eyes. Anyway, nice to meet you.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.first.2: Huh...? A visitor? Oh, hello there. Sorry if I seem a little out of it. It's been a very long morning... or was it afternoon?
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.first.3: Oh... hello. You wouldn't happen to know what time it is, would you? Never mind... doesn't really matter. Welcome, I suppose.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.first.4: Mmm... oh! Sorry, I nearly fell asleep standing up. That's becoming a rather bad habit. What was it you needed?
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.follow_no.1: Mmm... perhaps another time. I was just getting comfortable, and moving sounds like an awful lot of effort.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.follow_no.2: Oh... sorry, but I'm rather tired today. Maybe after a little nap?
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.follow_no.3: I'd love to, but... mmm... I think my bed needs me more right now.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.follow_stop: Oh... we're stopping? Wonderful. I think I'll head home and get some proper rest.
Mmm... that was nice. A little tiring, but nice. Let me know if you need me again.
Finally... a chance to sleep. Take care, %player%. And try not to wake me unless it's important.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.follow_talk: Mmm... are we there yet? No? Alright... just let me know when we are.
I'm still awake, %player%... mostly. Don't worry about me.
Could we take a little break soon? My legs are getting tired... and so are my eyes.
An adventure...? Mmm... alright. Sounds like a nice way to spend the day. Just let me bring my pillow.
Sure... why not? A little fresh air might actually help me stay awake.
Mmm, okay. I'll come along. But if we find a nice place to rest, we're stopping. No arguments.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.greeting.1: Mmm... %player%? Oh, it's you. Good... I was hoping someone interesting would show up today.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.greeting.2: Oh, hello again... I was just about to take a nap. Guess it can wait a little.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.greeting.3: Mmmh... nice to see you. Sorry, my eyes are a little heavy today. Well... heavier than usual.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.greeting.4: Oh... hey, %player%. How have you been? Tell me while I try not to fall asleep.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.hate.1: Ugh... what is this? Mmm... I don't even want to think about it. That's certainly not going to improve my day.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.like.1: Mmm! Oh, this is wonderful... You know exactly what I like, %player%. Now you've made my day a little brighter!
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.marriage_ac: Marriage...? Mmm... spending the rest of my life with you sounds rather nice. Someone to wake up beside... or perhaps someone to nap beside. Yes, %player%. I'd love to!
Oh... you really want to marry me? Even though I sleep through half the day? Mmm... well, I can't think of anyone I'd rather wake up for. Yes!
I don't need a grand wedding or a fancy castle. A cozy home, a warm bed, and you by my side... that sounds perfect. I accept.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.marriage_de: Mmm... that's a big question. I'd like to say yes, but I think I need a little more time to wake up to the idea. Please don't be upset.
Marriage sounds lovely, but... I'm not quite ready for such a big step. Could we take things slowly?
Oh... I care about you, truly. But I don't want to make such an important promise while I'm still unsure. I hope you understand.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.procreation: Mmm... not right now, love. I think we both deserve a little rest first. How about a nice, quiet nap together?
Oh... already? Mmm, let's take our time. There's no need to rush when we've got all the time in the world.
I'm feeling a little sleepy... again. Could we just cuddle for a while instead? That sounds much nicer right now.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.talk.1: Have you ever noticed how comfortable a bed feels when it's raining outside? The sound of raindrops against the window... honestly, there's nothing better.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.talk.2: People always say I'm wasting my days sleeping. But I say they're wasting their nights staying awake. Everyone needs a little more rest.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.talk.3: I once fell asleep under a tree and woke up with a squirrel sitting on my head. Strange little creature... didn't even say hello.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.talk.4: There's a lovely little meadow not far from here. Soft grass, warm sunlight, and hardly anyone around. Perfect for an afternoon nap... if you're interested.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.talk.5: Mmm... %player%, can I ask you something? If you had an entire day with absolutely nothing to do, how would you spend it? I'd probably stay in bed, but I'm curious what other people do with their free time.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.talk.6: Oh... that sounds exhausting. But I suppose there's something nice about seeing new places. Just remember to rest sometimes!
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.4.talk.7: Mmm... now that's someone with their priorities straight. I knew I liked you.
